description: ADTS of channel configuration 0 with a program config element of a front single channel element and an LFE element: the LFE of the first two blocks keeps to its restrictions, that of the last two has a Kaiser-Bessel derived window, coefficients above the lowest 12 and TNS.
findings: 2 raw data blocks hold an LFE channel stream with a Kaiser-Bessel derived window

skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder differs on the filter bank of the LFE.
